name: Freshchat
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI-powered customer messaging from Freshworks: live chat and chatbots across your website, app, WhatsApp and Instagram, with a unified agent inbox and automation that deflects repetitive questions.
best_for: small-to-mid support teams that want live chat and messaging with a real free tier to start
skip_if: you need a full help-desk and ticketing system, not just chat — look at a complete support suite instead of bolting on channels
honest_knock: The free tier is genuinely useful for small teams, but AI features and higher-tier routing sit behind paid plans and add-ons — and being part of the wider Freshworks suite means you'll be nudged toward the full platform.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per agent a month billed annually ($23 monthly)
pricing.notes: Read 1 Sep 2026 on freshworks.com/live-chat-software/pricing/ (USD fields of the page own plan data). Free is $0 for up to 10 agents. Per agent per month: Growth $19 billed annually or $23 monthly, Pro $49 or $59, Enterprise $79 or $95. Freddy AI is a separate bill, and both rates are published: the Freddy AI Copilot add-on is $29/agent/mo billed annually ($35 monthly), and Freddy AI Agent sessions cost $49 per 100 sessions beyond the 500 complimentary sessions each paid account receives once. Other add-ons on the same page: Freshcaller at $15/$39/$69 per agent per month annually ($18/$47/$83 monthly) on Growth/Pro/Enterprise, campaign contacts at $100, connector app tasks at $80, and day passes at $2/$7/$12.
